_about: Short hover lines for words whose reference or manual text runs past the hover rubric: one or two sentences, 25 words at most, pointing to the docs for the rest. Keys: a CoE5SE word, a CoE5SE form as word|form, or a game word as word|manual page. scripts/gen_vscode_data.py puts each in place of the long text and fails on any hover still over 25 words.
+setting: True when your setting is on, or with an index, when that option or key is picked. -setting is the opposite.
raisecorpses: Like raisedead, but turns the corpses on the caster's square into this monster. A number after the name sets the max.
doubledmgvs: Doubles the weapon's damage against units with the trait.
beamwidth: Widens the weapon's beam (aoe 10xx or 50xx) to this many squares. The side lanes hit the attacker's own units too; onlyenemy prevents it.
tag: Tags the monster for a weapon's onlyaffects, doesntaffect or doubledmgvs tag "<name>".
itemslots: Gives the monster this many slots of an item type. Its first itemslots line replaces vanilla's slots, so list each type it needs.
keepweapons: Makes each weapon item after the first add an attack, instead of going into another of the monster's damaging melee weapons.
killres: Makes the monster immune to instant death: a hit of exactly 999 does nothing to it, and casters skip it as a target.
polymorphres: Makes a polymorph weapon's hit (dmgtype 15) do nothing to the monster; casters skip it as a target.
petrifyres: Makes a petrify weapon's hit (dmgtype 24) do nothing to the monster; casters skip it as a target.
feebleres: Keeps the monster from becoming feebleminded in battle, by wound or affliction weapon; events and rituals still can.
expand_ritual_table: Does nothing now: CoE5SE always has room for 10000 mod rituals. Kept so older mods still load.
group: Stops the key settings of one group from holding the same key.
if: Starts the branches. Triggers above it hold for every branch; at most one if, before the first branch's actions.
needs_script_extender: CoE5SE ignores this line, and vanilla fails to load the mod. Put it in every mod that needs CoE5SE.
needs_glu32.dll_and_CoE5SE_enabled_at_la: The older name of needs_script_extender; it works the same.
needs_coe5se: Another name of needs_script_extender; it works the same.
newplane: Creates a plane. No other plane may share its name, a vanilla plane's short name included.
newspellpath: Creates a magic path. A name a vanilla or another mod's path already has shares that path.
or: Between groups of triggers: the event holds when every trigger of one group holds.
path: The spell's magic path: a game path's number, or a path's name in quotes. Needed.
planeicon: Sets the picture on the plane's map button, a 64 x 64 .tga or .png.
planelike: Builds the plane the way vanilla builds that plane: its map, ground pictures and independents.
planepopulate: Places that vanilla plane's independents on the plane, or none with off.
planeshape: Makes this monster turn into the named monster on that plane, as elysiumshape does on Elysium.
planesize: Sets the plane's width and height in squares. Needed unless planefile, or planelike Sky, Agartha, Hades or Inferno, gives the size.
randartifact|randartifact <nbr>: Gives the caster a random magic item from that group number, or from items in no group.
randartifact|randartifact <group>: Gives the caster a random magic item from that group, or from items in no group.
castermaxcast: Ritual cannot be cast more than this number of times per commander. At the limit it is greyed out.
randomequip: Gives the caster one item, picked at random from the ritual's addstring "|item" lines.
requires: Ensures that mod's DLLs and Lua scripts load before yours. Write it on a plain .c5m line; your mod loads without that mod.
personalmod: Makes your mod personal in LAN games: each player may run their own copy or none, and its script runs only on its player's machine.
nomultiplayer: Keeps your whole mod, scripts and content, out of LAN games on every machine, so no other player needs it.
restart: Asks the player to restart when they leave your page with the setting changed.
hated: Makes the unit hated as this kind: each turn, a hater on its team and square has a {{ game: HATES_KILL_CHANCE }}% chance to kill it.
hates: Makes the unit hate this kind: each turn, it has a {{ game: HATES_KILL_CHANCE }}% chance to kill one hated unit of its team on its square.
small: Makes the unit small: a Soulless raised from it is a Little Soulless. small 0 takes it off.
terraindecor: Gives the terrain's squares a vanilla terrain's decorations.
terrainground: Gives the terrain's squares a vanilla terrain's ground, or your picture in its place.
terrainsprite: Draws your picture in place of one decoration sprite, on this terrain only; its snow version is a separate sprite.
weapon: Sets the weapon the spell casts and its damage, as meleeweapon does for a monster.
addmercrec|Classes: Like addunitrec, but a green mercenary entry: recruited once, outside the recruitment limits.
addstartcom|Classes: Adds a starting commander; starting units added after it join its squad. Not for the main commander.
addstartunits|Classes: Adds nbr of this monster to the class's starting army. Use it once per monster type.
addstring|Rituals: Adds a text line to the ritual, usually a summoning string. Read before the ritual's other commands, wherever it sits.
addunitrec|Classes: Adds a monster to the class's recruitment list: its monthly chance, number, gold, an exploding gold die, and iron.
aialways|Rituals: At 100 the AI always casts it when it can, with no long plans; 999 also makes plans.
airare|Rituals: Lowers the AI's chance to cast the ritual, 1 to 99; -1 is never.
aiwhere|Rituals: Where the AI casts it: 1 seldom in plains or cities, 2 only in squares it wants to defend.
aoe|Weapons: Units hit near the target; 0 is one. Shapes such as cones are 4-digit numbers: aoe 3005 is a 5-square cone.
armor|Monsters: Armor value: 0 normal troops, 1 medium, 2 heavy, 3 Knights, 4 or more dragons.
assassinweapon|Monsters: A weapon for an assassination attempt before combat starts. Only the attacker uses it.
batmap|Terrain: The battle map the terrain fights on, mostly for forts and villages.
bentarg|Rituals: Gives the target a benefit mask; 2^26 is twiceborn, 2^24 Stygian Bath. Most benefits are temporary.
choosefxtarg|Rituals: The player picks a target unit with this fx; 0 any, -1 another player's units too.
classabdescr|Classes: The class's ability description, on one line; ^ starts a paragraph.
clearspec|Monsters: Removes every special ability from the monster, but not movement (clearmove does that).
combatspell|Items: A combat spell: -1 cast on round one, 1 the unit can cast it, 2 cast every round.
combatsum|Items: Summons in combat: -1 on round one, 1 every round. A ritual-style string, such as "2d4*Deer", without commanders.
cost|Rituals: A resource cost; cost 4 10 is 10 sacrifices. At most 4 costs.
deployoutside|Monsters: Deploys outside the fort in battle. Best for few, 1 x 1 monsters.
destroyto|Terrain: The terrain it becomes when destroyed or burnt. Usually not needed.
dmg|Weapons: The weapon's damage. 0, the default, makes it a natural weapon whose damage the monster sets.
dmgonterr|Monsters: Takes 1 damage a month in this terrain. Only one, the highest terrain number, counts.
drawsize|Monsters: Draws the unit this percent larger on its token, negative for smaller. Keep it small.
fastheal|Monsters: Heals any non-fatal damage within two months; afflictions take a few more.
flymode|Weapons: Shows a projectile for a ranged attack; with sprites, look picks the sprite.
fullsweep|Weapons: Hits every adjacent unit, each one after the first taking 1 less damage.
gems|Terrain: The square's gem income, a bitmask; at most 7 of one gem type.
goldbonus|Classes: Percent bonus to gold income, like the Baron's 25.
hasaffunithere|Events: True if player has a unit here with every affliction in the mask; -1 any player. Sets the target unit.
holdit|Events: 1: independents on this square stay. Cleared when the square is conquered or a unit spawns there.
hometerr|Classes: The class's home citadel terrain. Must be a citadel. Needed for a new class.
hp|Monsters: Maximum hit points: 6 a human soldier, 25 an ogre, 56 a troll, over 100 for giants and dragons.
ironbonus|Classes: Percent bonus to iron income, like the Baron's 25.
killunit|Events: Deals this damage to the target unit; 9999 or more ignores every ability, immortality included.
libmastery|Monsters: The library a level-up needs: 2 a magic library, 3 an academy of high magic. Needs mastery too.
lifeforce|Terrain: Lifeforce drainable from the square, x 10: a plain 10, a forest 30. Negative drains in that radius.
look|Weapons: The visual effect where the weapon strikes, such as a fireball's explosion.
makeben|Events: Gives the target unit a benefit; 2^26 is twiceborn, 2^24 Stygian Bath. Most benefits are temporary.
maxcast|Rituals: The most times each player can cast the ritual.
meleeweaponspec|Monsters: A special melee weapon, such as a lance: once used, later melee attacks are skipped.
minunitshere|Events: True if the event's square holds at least nbr of this exact monster, player's; -1 any player.
modprio|Index: Load order, 1 to 9, lower first; 5 by default. Usually not needed.
monplayerreq|Rituals: At least min (default 1) of the "(&)..." monsters must be alive and the caster's player's.
monworldreq|Rituals: At least min (default 1) of the "(&)..." monsters must be alive in the world.
mor|Monsters: Morale: 4 a human soldier, 8 or more powerful monsters, 15 fearless; 99 is Mindless.
motherspawn|Monsters: Spawns as one of the game's special spawners: 1 Mother of Monsters, 2 to 7 the teotls and the bloody mother.
mr|Monsters: Magic resistance: 2 animals, 4 humans, 6 apprentices, 8 mages, 9 master mages.
mundane|Weapons: Ethereal units ignore it 75% of the time. Most swords and spears are mundane.
mutate|Weapons: A victim it kills becomes the monster listed right after the killer, as Doppelganger makes Doppelspawn.
newmonster|Monsters: Creates a monster; the lines after it change it until another monster is set.
next|Weapons: A target this wounds is also hit by the next weapon in the mod. New weapons only.
nomonelysiumreq|Rituals: The "(-)..." monsters must not be in Elysium, the Sky or Agartha; a "(+)..." one lifts the minuses after it.
ornext|Rituals: Two possible effects: the next command, at this percent, or the rest.
ornext2|Rituals: Two possible effects: the next two commands, at this percent, or the rest.
ornext3|Rituals: Two possible effects: the next three commands, at this percent, or the rest.
otherplanar|Classes: The class survives without a citadel in Elysium.
plane|Events: True if the target square is on this plane; -1 all planes, -2 Elysium-like ones.
power|Monsters: A ritual school: 0 the last one made, -1 the one before; positive numbers are the game's.
primable|Monsters: -1 never a primal variant, 1 can be one. Animals can be by default.
promotion|Rituals: Promotes units to another monster, with addstring pairs: the source, then the result.
putcorpses|Rituals: Puts this many human corpses on the target square; add 10000 to scale with the sacrifices.
randitem|Events: Gives the target unit a random magic item for its slots, with this chance of a rare one.
randloc|Events: Moves the target to a random square on that plane and terrain. Not in squareevents.
rangedweapon50s|Monsters: A ranged weapon used in melee half the time, always at range; when used, the next weapon is skipped.
rangedweapon50x|Monsters: A ranged weapon used half the time, in melee or at range; when used, the next weapon is skipped.
reclimiter|Classes: Changes the last recruit's requirement: "+Baron" needs one, "-Baron" needs none alive, "=Dwarf Worker" upgrades them.
recxcost|Classes: Adds a special resource cost (not gold or iron) to the last recruit.
regeneration|Monsters: Heals 5% of its hit points each round, even when killed, unless far below 0.
reqterr|Classes: The map must have this terrain for the class to be played. One per class.
reveal|Events: Reveals the target square to a player, -1 all; radius in tenths of a square, 5 this square alone.
revertowner|Monsters: Who owns the monster once its player is defeated; 24 is the independents.
ritequipall|Rituals: Gives the target every item in the ritual's "|..." strings.
ritpow|Rituals: The ritual's school; without it, the latest newritpow.
sample|Events: Loads a .sw or .sw2 sample (16-bit, 22050 Hz) as sound 0 to 249; 170 and up are new.
sampleismusic|Events: Makes the sample a class tune that loops into the background music; on a background tune, removes it.
selectmonster|Monsters: Selects a monster for the lines after it, the first of that name; offset picks a later one.
selectritual|Rituals: Selects a ritual; offs picks a later one of that name.
selectterr|Terrain: Selects a terrain; 500 to 999 makes a new one. Ctrl-i shows a terrain's number.
selectterrgroup|Terrain: Selects a terrain group, -1000 to -1199; -1 to -999 are the game's.
selectweapon|Weapons: Selects a weapon by name or number. Ctrl-i on a unit shows weapon numbers.
setmaincom|Classes: The class's main commander, like the Baron's Baron. Not on its recruit list, it can't be replaced.
siegeweapon|Monsters: A weapon used in sieges, in the first ten rounds before normal attacks.
spellweapon|Monsters: A Cast Spell weapon in that path; in melee it works 25% of the time.
spellweaponsingle|Monsters: A limited Cast Spell weapon: one of these a round.
spr|Items: The item's picture, 32 x 32 or 64 x 64, the drawing at most 40 x 40.
spr1|Monsters: The monster's picture, also its attack picture: 32 x 32 or 64 x 64, 128 x 128 for huge ones.
spr2|Monsters: The monster's attack picture. After spr1.
startplane|Classes: The plane the citadel starts on. Needs createcit and a portal terrain as hometerr.
str|Monsters: Strength: 4 a human soldier, 8 a troll, 10 to 12 giants and dragons.
summoning|Rituals: Summons one of the ritual's addstring strings, at random: "1d6*Goblin", "c*Captain & 2d6*Spearman".
teleportloc|Rituals: Teleports to the target square: 1 the target, 2 the caster's army, 3 the target and its army.
tradebonus|Classes: Percent bonus to trade income, like the Senator's 50.
transformtarg|Rituals: Transforms the target into the addstring monster. Use 1; 2 picks a higher one for a skilled caster.
turnnbr|Events: True on this turn. Turn 0 runs before the first player's turn, turn -1 before the game starts.
visible|Terrain: Draws the sprite as terrain, for changing forests, mountains and villages.
newfaction: Creates a faction; its name shows wherever CoE5 names a player.
factionlike: Clones a vanilla faction's rules; each line your block leaves out keeps the cloned faction's.
factionhome: Sets the faction's home plane: where its citadel spawns, its gateway leads, and its wanderers wait.
factionactive: Sets when the faction is active, which its citadel spawns and waiting wanderers need; portals waits for that many open gateways to its home.
factionpopulate: Makes the independents on its home owned by the faction; that home must be one of your planes. You usually want this.
factionworldevents: Lets the world events that act on the Independents act on the faction too.
factionspawnsite: Sets where the faction spawns its units: its citadel on its home, its monuments, or nowhere.
factionspawn: Adds a spawn the faction tries each turn at its sites; each site sends only the first spawn that passes, so declare the biggest first.
factionmonumentevent: Lets the faction found its monument on a square the Independents own.
factionplaneshift: Moves the monster from the faction's home to the matching square on Elysium while the faction's monument stands.
factiongateway: Sets the ruined gateway on Elysium the faction's carriers restore, and where it leads on the faction's home.
factioncaravan: Gives the faction a caravan, beside vanilla's caravan.
factionhorrors: Gives the faction a share of the Horrors' spawns.
factionavoid: Makes the faction's armies step onto another faction's armies only at that chance. The first factionavoid replaces the cloned faction's list.
factionunits: At world generation, the faction places owned units on free squares and owns each square.
factionpopulateterrain: Independents that world generation placed on that terrain are then owned by the faction, along with their squares.
combatcaster: Gives the Combat Caster trait. combatcaster 0 takes it off.
newspell: Creates a spell, followed by the commands that shape the spell.
level|CoE5SE: Inside a newspell block: sets the spell's level, 1 to 3.
slowcast: Makes the spell take 2 combat rounds to cast.
notsea: Stops units casting the spell at sea.
notunderground: Stops units casting the spell underground.
prioritylearn: A unit that starts with spells learns this one before the others of its path and level.
heallivingarmy: The units in the caster's army that heal at all heal half their maximum Hit Points a turn while the caster knows the spell.
healhumanarmy: The humans & hoburghers in the caster's army heal half their maximum Hit Points a turn while the caster knows the spell.
healarmy: Makes the units with the trait in the caster's army heal half their maximum Hit Points a turn while the caster knows the spell.
burnforest|CoE5SE: Inside a newspell block: the caster has Burn Forest while it knows the spell.
selectspellpath: Selects a path to rename for every mod; follow it with vanilla's name line.
spellweapon|CoE5SE: Takes a path's name in double quotes where vanilla takes its number. Put the line in the .c5se or on a #!@ line.
newnametype: Creates a list of commander names; naming the list again, in any mod, adds to it.
addname: Adds a name to the list above.
fixedname: Gives every commander of this monster this name. Goes after newmonster or selectmonster.
spawnoffs|CoE5SE: Takes a monster's name in double quotes where vanilla takes an offset. The monster must exist before this line.
gainrit|CoE5SE: Takes a ritual's name in double quotes where vanilla takes an offset. The ritual must exist before this line.
templerec|CoE5SE: Sets the chance each temple adds; every temple counts, not vanilla's 5.
libraryrec|CoE5SE: Sets the chance each library level adds; every level counts, not vanilla's 10.
atavirec|CoE5SE: Sets the chance each Atavi Tribe Village adds.
reclimiter|CoE5SE: Sets the chance each unit of the $ monster adds.
randartifact: Gives the caster a random magic item; with a group, from that group or from items in no group.
noexplode: Stops the weapon's damage die, or the dice of the addstring above, from exploding.
corpsetype: Sets the corpse the active monster leaves when it dies, whatever its traits.
newcorpsetype: Declares a new corpse type for your monsters to leave and your rituals and events to use.
needcorpses: Ritual cannot be cast unless the caster's square has a corpse its raisedead, raiseanimals or raisecorpses commands can use.
maxraise: Ritual cannot create more than this number of units in one cast, from all its raisedead, raiseanimals and raisecorpses commands together.
reanimate|CoE5SE: A victim killed by the weapon becomes this monster instead of a Soulless; with a corpse type, only victims that leave a corpse of that type.
mutate|CoE5SE: A victim killed by the weapon becomes this monster, instead of the monster that follows the killer in the monster list.
excludecorpses: raisedead, raiseanimals and raisecorpses in this ritual will not use corpses of this type, except a raisecorpses that names it.
raisedead|CoE5SE: With a type, Raise Dead will only use corpses of this type; same for raiseanimals. A number after the type sets the max.
putcorpses|CoE5SE: With a type, creates corpses of this type instead of human corpses. Also takes dice for a random amount, like 1d6+100, and works in events.
planefill: Sets the terrain every square starts as. Needed, unless the plane has planelike or planefile.
planefile: Reads the plane's squares from a map file; with planelike too, only the file's square names and portals stay.
planepiece: Stamps a map file into the built plane.
planezone: Creates a zone around each copy of a planepiece file; the zone lines below act on it.
planezoneswap: Turns each square of the first terrain in the zone into the second.
planezoneunits: Gives the zone only these monsters instead of its independents.
planezonepopulate: Places no independents in the zone.
planeunits: Gives the plane only these monsters, outside zones with their own.
planeswap|CoE5SE: Inside a newplane block: turns each square of the first terrain into the second, after the independents are placed.
planereq|CoE5SE: Takes a plane's name in double quotes where vanilla takes its number. Put the line in the .c5se or on a #!@ line.
factionfuel: Sets the monster the faction uses up to spawn units.
factionwander: Sets the wander command the faction's commanders follow.
factionwandergate: Makes the faction's wanderers wait on its home until the faction is active; needs factionwander infwander or celwander.
factionmonument: Sets the monster the faction uses as its monument.
factionmonumentrule: Lets the faction's monument on Elysium stop a player from ruling Elysium.
factionloyalty: Makes every unit of the monster on the monument's plane owned by the faction while the faction's monument stands.
factiongather: Makes the faction's units with this ability gather its fuel from Elysium's settlements and bring it home.
factiontithe: Sends the gold of the faction's squares to the Tithe of El. You usually want this.
factionconquest: Sets how players conquer the faction's squares: as the Independents' squares, or as any faction's.
factionstatue: Makes the Imperial Statue and the wanderers that seek cities count the faction's squares.
elseif: Starts another branch: its triggers, then its actions. It runs only if no branch before it ran.
else: Starts the last branch: its actions run when no branch before it ran, on every turn the event checks.
newsetting: Creates a setting on your mod's Mod Settings page.
onoff: Makes the setting an on/off checkmark.
choice: Makes the setting a list of options; the player picks one.
key: Makes the setting a hotkey the player picks; your Lua script reads it and gives the key its job.
label: Sets the setting's text on the page, or a sub-page's name.
option: Adds an option to a choice setting.
tip: Sets the hover text of an onoff or key setting.
fixed: Stops the player changing a key setting.
parent: Puts an onoff or key setting under an onoff setting: one switch for a group. They are greyed out and off while it is off.
newsettingheader: Puts the onoff and key settings after it in a box with this title.
newsettingpage: Puts the settings after it on a sub-page, up to the next newsettingpage.
maxdata: Sets the room, in MB, for the data files your Lua script saves; 10 without the line.
include: Lets you split your mod into as many .c5se files and folders as you wish. Put include lines only in your mod's root files.
selectclass|CoE5SE: Picks a class by string, since a mod's class number changes with the mods on. The class's mod must load before yours.
clearspec|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: removes everything special the item gives: every ability (armor, hp and other bonuses included), combatsum, combatspell, and its holder's afflictions and special benefits. The name, sprite, type and rarity stay.
clearweapons|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: removes the item's itemwep weapon.
makeaff|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: the holder has this affliction while it holds the item. Bitmask values as for the event command makeaff.
cureoneaff|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: using the item has this chance of healing one battle affliction, like the Elixir of Health.
newspell1|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: using the item teaches this many new level 1 spells of the holder's own path, like a spell scroll.
newspell2|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: using the item teaches this many new level 2 spells of the holder's own path, like a spell scroll.
newspell3|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: using the item teaches this many new level 3 spells of the holder's own path, like a spell scroll.
extralife: After newitem or selectitem: when the holder dies, the item is destroyed and the holder lives again, like a Soul Stone.
eyeitem: After newitem or selectitem: the item is an eye, like the Spirit Eye; only a unit with a free eye can hold it.
heartitem: After newitem or selectitem: the item is a heart, like the Crystal Heart; a lifeless unit cannot hold it. heartitem 2: any unit can.
usereveal: After newitem or selectitem: using the item shows its player every square of this terrain, like the Map of Kokytos.
useteleport: After newitem or selectitem: using the item teleports the whole army to this terrain, like the Scroll of Astral Travel.
useplanetravel: After newitem or selectitem: using the item takes the army to this terrain and back to Elysium, like the Tome of Afterlife.
usebeanstalk: After newitem or selectitem: using the item grows a beanstalk with a portal to the plane above, like the Magic Bean.
usepit: After newitem or selectitem: using the item digs a pit with a portal to a plane below, like the Portable Pit.
usebreakseal: After newitem or selectitem: using the item breaks one of the seven seals, like the Heavenly Seal.
useonlyin: After newitem or selectitem: the item can only be used on this terrain, like the Magic Bean.
useableitem: After newitem or selectitem: the holder can use the item and keep it, like a tome. useableitem 0 takes it off.
consumableitem: After newitem or selectitem: the holder can use the item once, like a scroll; using it destroys it. consumableitem 0 takes it off.
makeben|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: the holder has this special benefit while it holds the item. Bitmask values as for the event command makeben.
clearmove|CoE5SE: After newitem or selectitem: removes all movement attributes from the item.
aiclass|CoE5SE: Takes the class away from every player, human and AI. Leave enough classes for every Random player.
terrainlooks: Starts the looks of a mod's terrain; follow it with terrainground or terraindecor.
onlyaffects: Makes the weapon affect only units with the trait.
doesntaffect: Makes units with the trait unaffected by the weapon.
mincorpses|CoE5SE: With a type: +mincorpses, -mincorpses and removecorpses count and take only that type.
greedy: Not in the manual. The unit card shows it as Greedy.
vengeance: The unit card shows it as Blood Vengeance (+n). The manual lists it without a description.
holyvengeance: Not in the manual. The unit card shows it as Holy Vengeance (+n).
affectfemale: Not in the manual: the weapon word beside affectmale, which the manual says won't affect females.
coeversion: Not in the manual: the CoE5 version the mod is made for, read with its icon and description.
modversion: Not in the manual: the mod's version, a number like 1.2, read with its icon and description.
citadel2: A wander word the manual lists with the other wander words, without a description.
end: Not described in the manual: a vanilla word of monster modding, beside newmonster and copystats.
meleeweaponlong: Not in the manual: a vanilla word beside meleeweapon, with no meaning on record yet.
eastcoast: Not in the manual: a vanilla monster word beside forest and deepspawn, with no meaning on record yet.
seasonleft: Not in the manual: an event trigger beside +season, with no meaning on record yet.
